'''Quar Rohk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Thief/Legends|thief-for-hire]] that lived and operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was present at the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], attempting to steal [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline vertex]] from the [[B'omarr Monastery]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. While in the monastery, Rohk encountered a [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|Tethan youngling]].

==Behind the scenes==
Quar Rohk's only appearance was in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'', a young readers novel published in [[July]] [[2010]]. It was based on [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|the ''Clone Wars film'']].
